# What do we do when sampling MPC for reasoning requires large rollout, but the general simulator cannot meet the real-time budget?

> **Current answer:** The case uses a task-specific simulator: RGB real2sim mapping, running 256 parallel environments on a single RTX 4090, with H=5 MPPI, for real-time refinement of the base strategy trajectory.
